concept: 透视攻击与牵制的区别
question_cn: 透视攻击与牵制（Pin）的关键区别是什么？
question_en: What is the key difference between an X-ray attack and a pin?

options.text_cn: 透视攻击和牵制完全一样，没有区别
options.text_en: X-ray attacks and pins are exactly the same

options.text_cn: 牵制中中间棋子移走会暴露后方目标；透视攻击中进攻方已穿越过去直接盯住后方目标
options.text_en: In a pin, moving the intervening piece exposes the target behind it; in an X-ray attack, the attacking piece already targets the piece beyond it

options.text_cn: 牵制只能用马，透视攻击只能用象
options.text_en: Only knights can create pins, while only bishops can make X-ray attacks

options.text_cn: 透视攻击只在将军时有效
options.text_en: X-ray attacks are effective only when they give check

explanation_cn: 牵制：进攻方棋子盯住中间棋子，中间棋子移走则暴露后方的王或重子。透视攻击：进攻方棋子穿越中间棋子，直接威胁后方目标，中间棋子的移动会让威胁立即兑现。两者常配合使用。
explanation_en: In a pin, the attacker targets the intervening piece because moving it would expose a more valuable piece behind it. In an X-ray attack, the attacker directly targets the deeper piece through the intervening piece. The two ideas can also work together.
